note: Set A is better because it more accurately extracts the explicit numerical values from the text for gains at 0 degrees (KP, KI, KD), whereas Set B repeatedly hallucinates incorrect values for the integral gain at 0 degrees (claiming 0.005, 0.007, 0.3 instead of 0.008068634). Both sets contain significant errors when interpreting the graph data for other angles (often ignoring the right-axis scale), but Set A has fewer of these gross magnitude errors. Set B does correctly extract the gain-correction formula which Set A misses, but this does not outweigh the numerous incorrect numerical claims.
